subject: general
question: In April 2025, the DRDO and the Indian Army successfully conducted four flight-tests of which missile system from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medium-Range Surface-to-Air Missile (MRSAM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Medium-Range Surface-to-Air Missile (MRSAM)** is an advanced air defense missile system developed jointly by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** and **Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI)**.
 
• The missile system successfully conducted **four flight-tests** in April 2025 from the **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island** off the coast of Odisha, India.
 
• MRSAM is designed to provide **multi-layered air defense** against enemy aircraft, missiles, and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).
 
• The system has a range of approximately **70 kilometers** and features **advanced radar, command-and-control systems, and mobile launchers**.
 
• It is a critical component of India’s defense capabilities, aimed at strengthening airspace security for the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island:** Formerly known as Wheeler Island, it is an integrated test range for missile systems located in Odisha, used for testing various indigenous and strategic missile systems.
 
• **Features of MRSAM:** Includes advanced phased-array radar, interceptor missiles with advanced guidance, and a mobile launcher system to ensure high precision and mobility.
 
• **Collaborative Development:** MRSAM is a joint venture between DRDO and IAI, showcasing India-Israel defense cooperation in missile technology.
 
• **Operational Role:** The system is tailored for both offensive and defensive roles, capable of neutralizing aerial threats in diverse combat scenarios.
 
• **Previous Tests:** MRSAM has undergone multiple successful tests since its inception, validating its performance and reliability under various operational conditions.
